reviews.title: New Keyboard , fewer features
reviews.comment: Nice keyboard  very solid  my issue  is most previous versions of Logitech boards with G -Keys  you could could  use the keys to navigate to 30 website  which is all I used the for  M1,M2,M3 x 10  G keys for. This new board will only do 10  macros  and will not save websites to them. I am not impressed Logi says the programming may come  so I  can do at least 10 websites  but no date  on that happening
reviews.author: Roger S.
